integrity: Exact universal proof provided; finite rational checks supplement but do not certify all instances. Publication priority assessed by comparison with accessible source material; independent external validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional equal-weight agents; deterministic ex-post alpha-PF, arbitrary positive alpha, absolute distances and utilitarian welfare. title: Exact coalition envelopes and welfare optima for proportionally fair obnoxious facilities
